Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Wrike is our people, not a place. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div><p>As an Account Executive 3 at Wrike, you will play a critical role in landing key enterprise accounts. You’ll own the full sales cycle with new logos, engaging at C-suite/executive level, partnering with cross-functional teams, and demonstrating Wrike’s impact on enterprise transformation and ROI. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your consultative approach and tenacity will directly unlock new business and deepen Wrike’s brand as a leader in the market.</p> <p>If you’re a collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys connecting technology solutions to real business challenges, we want to hear from you!</p> <h3>Your Impact:</h3> <ul> <li>Develop, manage, and close complex sales cycles; prospecting, leading discovery, presenting business cases, negotiating contracts, and landing new logos at the enterprise level (5,000+ employees).</li> <li>Deliver compelling presentations and business cases to executive audiences, demonstrating strategic thinking, business acumen, and exceptional consultative communication skills.</li> <li>Provide highly accurate and insight-driven monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline forecasts, and maintain meticulous CRM (Salesforce) hygiene.</li> <li>Serve as an expert consultant on digital and operational transformation; drive opportunities to upsell, cross-sell, and expand engagement within enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Proactively lead and coordinate cross-functional account teams—including Marketing, Sales Development, Solution Consultants, Legal, Security, and Implementation—to deliver a world-class enterprise client experience.</li> <li>Skillfully navigate complex legal, procurement, compliance, and security processes in collaboration with internal teams and enterprise client stakeholders.</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of SaaS trends and industry best education, and readiness across large buying groups.</li> <li>Ensure a seamless and comprehensive handoff to Customer Success and Implementation teams, clearly documenting goals, expectations, and key learnings for ongoing client engagement.</li> <li>Regularly capture and communicate enterprise customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership for continuous improvement.</li> <li>Mentor and support development of junior account executives, sharing best practices and contributing to team enablement initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Your multiple stakeholders)</li> <li>Demonstrated success executing complex deals with Fortune 1000/Global 5000 organizations and C-suite stakeholders</li> <li>Skilled in delivering consultative, solution-based sales cycles using methodologies like MEDDIC, Challenger, or Question-Based Selling</li> <li>Outstanding executive presence, business acumen, and ability to translate technical value quotas</li> <li>Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills; comfortable leading high-stakes executive meetings and product demos</li> <li>Experience managing legal, procurement, and information security processes for large enterprise agreements</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce and the modern SaaS sales tech stack</li> </ul> <h3>Standout Qualities:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in work management, project management, or a track record of selling to our ideal customer profiles (ICPs) in Marketing, Professional Services, Manufacturing or Engineering</li> <li>Fluent in German and English (verbal &amp; Written)</li> </ul> <h3>Team Dynamics:</h3> <p>You’ll join Wrike’s high-performing New Business team, where your primary focus will be acquiring new enterprise customers and driving revenue growth. As a key member of our enterprise sales organization, you’ll play a critical role in expanding Wrike’s presence by landing new logos, shaping our go-to-market strategy, and fueling our continued growth in the enterprise segment.</p> <h3>Our Work Style:</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborative Culture: Work alongside ambitious, supportive colleagues who celebrate wins together</li> <li>Comprehensive Training: Structured onboarding and ongoing sales enablement to help you master our product and refine your skills</li> <li>Work Flexibility: Options for remote work with the support you need to succeed from your home or the office</li> <li>Competitive Compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission structure that rewards performance</li> </ul> <h3>Growth Opportunities:</h3> <p>Clear career progression paths with opportunities to advance into senior account management or leadership roles, based on your performance and goals</p> <p class="p1">Your recruitment buddy will be&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/azizatalhi/"><span class="s1">Aziza Talhi</span></a>, Senior Recruiter.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">#LI-AT1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Who Is Wrike and Our Culture</strong></h3> <div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div> <div><strong>Hybrid work mode</strong></div> <div><br> <div> <div>Wrike is our people, not a place.
